name: start
summary: UI_SPArena_Start. Host callbacks are the four original trap/UI boundaries.

name: playerIconHandle
summary: PlayerIconHandle is a typed registration boundary in the native host.

name: projectPointOntoVector
summary: BASIC MATH from cm_trace.c.  These stay here beside the brush kernel so capsule primitives and their differential tests share the exact binary32 operation ordering of the original C translation unit.

name: AllocWinding
summary: Managed equivalents of the original zone-allocation helpers. Productive collision code uses plain point arrays; these retain the original lifetime errors for callers that need the explicit AllocWinding/FreeWinding surface.

name: CM_TestBoxInBrush
summary: Public spellings retained by the original qcommon collision API.

name: SetPlaneSignbits
summary: BSPC's local SetPlaneSignbits and the qcommon loader use the same bit order.

name: packFloat
summary: Round an exact integer significand times 2^power to binary32 (nearest-even).

name: clientGameCommand
summary: qcommon/Cmd_ExecuteString callback chain.  These callbacks deliberately use the already-tokenized shared command state, which is also what trap_Argv and trap_Args read while the QVM export is running.

name: drawCgameProductive
summary: The native cgame mirror above is a differential-audit observer. Running it and rescanning its complete cvar table on every retail-QVM frame contributes no authoritative output. The playable path therefore executes only the original cgame QVM; probes continue to use drawCgame and retain the observer.

name: observeNativeEffects
summary: Feed the native cg_effects mirror from the semantic event stream.  These calls execute the original parameter and lifetime logic but remain non-dispatching while cgame.qvm owns presentation.

name: observeNativeWeapons
summary: Run weapon side effects from the same decoded event records.  The native mirror resolves media, traces and impact decisions while retail cgame.qvm remains the only dispatcher.

name: R_LINKED
summary: The pinned 1.32b g_public.h intentionally embeds entityState_t at the start of entityShared_t. gentity_t consequently contains s followed by r.s and the engine-owned shared fields below. These are QVM byte offsets, not host layout.

name: snapshotProductive
summary: Production snapshots are consumed by the authoritative retail cgame QVM. Differential native prediction/effect/HUD mirrors belong in probes, not in the frame loop; they otherwise duplicate most client work for every tick.

name: UserSettings
summary: The original engine keeps one cvar/key/userinfo store alive while moving from ui.qvm into a local game.  MiniQuake3 boots the heavy game host only after the UI selects a map, so explicitly carry that persistent state across the host boundary instead of silently reverting menu choices and bindings.

name: renderTrianglesCached
summary: Produces renderer-neutral animated triangles for the playable preview.

name: openStandard
summary: Mount the standard Baseq3 patch set with the same higher-pak precedence as Quake III.  The retail CD has pak0/pak1; patched 1.32 installations may provide through pak8.  Duplicate qpaths are indexed only once.

name: EnemyAnimationState
summary: Standalone hostile-preview animation controller. One-shot sequences keep their final frame in the returned sample and change state for the next call.

name: enemySelect
summary: Baseq3 has no player pain row; TORSO_GESTURE is used as the preview flinch.

name: lerpFrame
summary: Stateful CG_SetLerpFrameAnimation / CG_RunLerpFrame.  Unlike sample(), this preserves the original initial-lerp, animation-toggle and hitch-clamp state across rendered frames.

name: parse
summary: Matches CG_ParseAnimationFile, including optional directives, the lower.md3 frame-base correction, negative numFrames reversal and zero-fps fallback.

name: sample
summary: Samples a sequence at elapsed milliseconds. backlerp is the weight of oldFrame expected by md3.renderTriangles/LerpMeshVertexes.

name: VmHeader
summary: Managed mirrors keep the original member order. Variable-sized tails are represented by ordinary arrays and all on-disk decoding remains explicit.

name: adler32
summary: The original file embeds zlib 1.1.3. These names own that internal surface; the port funnels all actual DEFLATE work through the bounded RFC1951 decoder.

name: BotAI_Print
summary: Botlib import boundaries from the first section of ai_main.c.

name: RemoveColorEscapeSequences
summary: Direct native ownership delegates to the already isolated ai_main sections.

name: BotValidTeamLeader
summary: Original exported spellings retained for symbol-level port auditing.

name: create_acostable
summary: create_acostable (#if 0 and additionally block-commented in the original)

name: disabledIf0Symbols
summary: These original symbols are compiled out by #if 0 in bg_lib.c.  They are retained below for source completeness, but are never selected by Q3_VM.

name: floor
summary: The following are complete callable translations of the original #if 0 block. floor (#if 0)

name: memmove
summary: memmove; offsets make pointer aliasing explicit in the safe runtime.

name: qsort
summary: qsort -- native typed-array equivalent of the original byte/element API.

name: srand
summary: srand / rand use the original 32-bit LCG.

name: sscanf
summary: sscanf preserves the original implementation's count bug (always zero).

name: strchr
summary: strchr -- a C pointer result is represented by its byte offset, or -1.

name: strstr
summary: strstr -- a C pointer result is represented by its byte offset, or -1.

name: tan
summary: tan is active in Q3_VM and uses the active sine/cosine intrinsics.

name: vsprintf
summary: vsprintf uses an array as the typed va_list boundary.

name: MOD_GRAPPLE
summary: Baseq3 ends at 23. Missionpack inserts five values before its grapple (28).

name: NumPlayersOnSameTeam
summary: NumPlayersOnSameTeam (the i+1 test preserves the original game's indexing behavior).

name: inFieldOfVision
summary: Exact aliases for the remaining existing native implementations.

name: getLongTermGoal
summary: ai_dmnet.c BotGetLongTermGoal: common Baseq3 and CTF long-term goal policy.

name: longTermGoal
summary: ai_dmnet.c BotLongTermGoal: leading policy before the LTG dispatcher.

name: voiceChat
summary: These are intentional no-ops in the original baseq3 build; their bodies only contain missionpack commands when MISSIONPACK is defined.

name: skin
summary: The original ForceClientSkin helper is commented out in the pinned source, but the inventory intentionally retains its parsed `skin` parameter.  Keep the exact useful transformation available without mutating caller storage.

name: trap_DropClient
summary: Game logic never calls ClientDisconnect directly when kicking a client. Keep the syscall boundary explicit so the engine performs its housekeeping and calls ClientDisconnect back through vmMain in the original order.

name: ClientCommand
summary: GAME_CLIENT_COMMAND uses this entry after the server has tokenized the reliable command.  Keeping ClientCommand itself argv-based avoids a second tokenizer on the normal engine path.

name: ClientCommandText
summary: Productive server adapter for a raw reliable command.  It deliberately uses the shared Cmd_TokenizeString implementation, then invokes the same QAGame entry as VM GAME_CLIENT_COMMAND.

name: declarationNames
summary: Complete declaration inventory for static parity checks. Calls are routed to their owning game, syscall, bot or AAS module rather than duplicated here.

name: PlayerTeamState
summary: Managed mirrors for the records which are independent from the much larger live Entity/Client/Level aggregates.  Opaque engine records are retained as ordinary values, just as the other MiniLang game facades do.

name: Runtime
summary: Runtime keeps the engine-owned inputs which native qagame obtains through traps.  Function slots default to the real port, while making the ABI switch independently differential-testable without replacing gameplay code.

name: vmMain
summary: vmMain -- the only qagame export.  The return values and command ordering match the pinned Baseq3 switch; unknown commands return -1.

name: utilities
summary: `utilities` is a false-positive candidate produced by the historical inventory parser from the "calculations in the utilities" comment.  Keep a named, side-effect-free compatibility entry so the pinned 20-name ledger is exhaustively represented without inventing a Quake entity behavior.

name: invulnerabilityEffect
summary: Exact RaySphereIntersections/G_InvulnerabilityEffect geometry used by the Team Arena projectile reflection branch.

name: between
summary: Kept because the historical symbol inventory picked the word from the g_trigger.c comments. It is also useful to contracts that describe the inclusive trigger ranges; it is not an upstream C function.

name: promotedFloatLow
summary: The original trap_BotMutateGoalFuzzyLogic omits PASSFLOAT. On the 32-bit DLL ABI its float parameter is promoted to binary64 and the syscall reads the low 32-bit word. Preserve that historical ABI quirk exactly.

name: frame
summary: Quake's event loop consumes input before advancing server and client state. Time never moves backwards and large desktop stalls are capped per frame.

name: Services
summary: All effects are explicit so startup rollback and frame ordering can be checked without substituting the protocol or UDP implementations.

name: shutdown
summary: Release every resource that was acquired. Keep attempting later cleanup steps if an earlier close reports an error, and return the first failure.

name: initializeConfiguration
summary: Completes the common startup portion after cvars, commands, filesystem and client input have initialized.  Baseq3 registers writeconfig during Com_Init and only enables automatic writes at the very end of that routine.

name: serverTick
summary: desktop_frame_host calls this after the network pump, preserving Quake's event-before-simulation rule.

name: dispatch
summary: Productive Com_EventLoop input half. A desktop window adapter only has to enqueue events; engine callbacks stay independent of the native GUI API.

name: K_MWHEELDOWN
summary: Baseq3 key numbers from keys.h. A wheel notch is represented as a complete key press so bindings cannot remain stuck when a host only reports deltas.

name: queueEvent
summary: Exact ownership rule of Sys_QueEvent for input-only events: overwrite the oldest slot on overflow, then append at the current head position.

name: headlessMain
summary: Bounded equivalent of the original endless headless main loop.

name: BLEND_GL_STATE
summary: Generic OpenGL blend state.  Low nibble is GLS_SRCBLEND_*, high nibble is GLS_DSTBLEND_* and bit 8 distinguishes it from the optimized legacy modes.

name: mapGammaMax
summary: mapGammaMax is disabled in the released build.  Preserve the exact initial probe ramp so the dormant diagnostic can still be compared and inspected.

name: GLWState
summary: Native handles and callbacks are represented by managed host handles.  The field order mirrors the original records; the constants below retain the original 32-bit ABI used by the released Windows executable.

name: logFunctionNames
summary: The original declares one typed forwarding wrapper for every core GL call. MiniLang has managed arguments, so dispatch owns the common forwarding and logging semantics while this complete inventory preserves every entrypoint. win_qgl.c's logFoo wrappers are a one-to-one projection of qglFoo. Keeping the canonical qgl inventory as the source prevents the two 336-entry lists from silently diverging while retaining complete wrapper coverage.

name: CPUID
summary: CPUID exposes the four values win_shared consumes. Vendor text is irrelevant to the original decision after its vendor restriction was removed.

name: SNDDMA_GetDMAPos
summary: SNDDMA_GetDMAPos (the inventory extractor calls this candidate `position`).

name: SNDDMA_InitDS
summary: SNDDMA_InitDS. Capability results are supplied by the Win32 host adapter.

name: ConWndProc
summary: ConWndProc. This preserves every state-changing branch of the Win32 callback.

name: InputLineWndProc
summary: InputLineWndProc. Message names model WM_KILLFOCUS and WM_CHAR.

name: addContextCommand
summary: Context-bearing registrations keep subsystem state out of the global command state while leaving the original Cmd_AddCommand surface unchanged.

name: filterName
summary: Case-insensitive Com_Filter subset used by Cmd_List_f, including Baseq3's *, ?, bracket ranges and doubled opening/closing bracket conventions.

name: commandCallback
summary: Cmd_AddCommand("writeconfig", Com_WriteConfig_f).  The command registry owns the association so several isolated engine runtimes can coexist in tests and tools without a process-global configuration pointer.

name: configFilename
summary: Q_strncpyz followed by COM_DefaultExtension, both constrained by MAX_QPATH.

name: writeConfiguration
summary: Com_WriteConfiguration: archive dirtiness is consumed before attempting the write, matching the original failure behavior.

name: commandCompletion
summary: Cvar_CommandCompletion preserves the linked-list order (newest first).

name: configLine
summary: Cvar_WriteVariables.  Registry.variables is kept in the original linked-list order (newest first), so this text is also byte ordered like q3config.cfg. The native routine formats each line through a 1024-byte stack buffer.

name: generateHashValue
summary: generateHashValue: the original uses the ASCII-lowercased byte multiplied by its one-based position plus 118, then masks into 256 buckets.

name: infoString
summary: Cvar_InfoString and Cvar_InfoString_Big deliberately differ in insertion order because the unchanged q_shared helpers prepend small pairs and append big pairs.

name: restart
summary: Cvar_Restart_f resets registered variables while preserving the stable numeric handle table used by vmCvar_t. User-created entries disappear from the linked-list view. The 1.32b source uses sizeof(var), where var is a pointer, so its x86 memset clears only the leading name pointer. Preserve that shipped behavior while avoiding access through the list.

name: compressPacket
summary: Packet-level adaptive codec used by Huff_Compress/Huff_Decompress.  The first two bytes store the uncompressed length in network byte order; the bitstream starts at bit 16 and Baseq3 reserves one final padding byte.

name: Encode
summary: C-named little-endian conversion helpers.  The original functions accept output pointers; the native facade returns the produced buffer/word array so callers cannot observe partially initialized storage.

name: copy
summary: MSG_Copy preserves all source cursor/state fields and installs independent storage containing the bytes written so far.  Baseq3 deliberately retains src->maxsize; length is only the destination-capacity guard.

name: keyMask
summary: This is deliberately the original table rather than a derived bits-wide mask: MSG_ReadDeltaKey indexes kbitmask with bits, not bits-1.

name: entityOffsets
summary: Struct byte offsets in the exact, deliberately hand-tuned wire order of msg.c.

name: readDeltaEntity
summary: The entity number has already been consumed, as in MSG_ReadDeltaEntity.

name: writeDeltaEntity
summary: Returns true when a record was emitted. A void `nextState` emits a remove record.

name: MSG_initHuffman
summary: Baseq3 trains the global compressor and decompressor identically. Messages own immutable equivalents in MiniLang, avoiding process-global mutation.

name: scramblePacket
summary: These two routines are inside Baseq3's #if 0 block, but keeping the exact transform here makes the complete source-file contract available to tools and preserves the original reversible packet codec.

name: drain
summary: Drain currently available datagrams up to an explicit per-frame budget. A zero budget is useful for callers that only want deterministic accounting.

name: pumpOnce
summary: Consume at most one datagram.  When both queues are ready, alternate the first socket examined so neither side can starve the other.

name: visibleFaces
summary: Resolve the face list referenced by a set of visible BSP leaves. The result retains first occurrence order and removes faces shared by several leaves.

name: wireframe
summary: Faces use meshvert indexes relative to firstVert, exactly like srfSurfaceFace_t and srfTriangles_t. Shared triangle edges are emitted once.

name: colorShiftLighting
summary: R_ColorShiftLightingBytes. The dependency-free software renderer has no hardware gamma ramp, so tr.overbrightBits is zero while Baseq3's default r_mapOverBrightBits remains two.

name: extractWithPatchError
summary: Face and meshvert order is retained. Repeated face indexes are ignored after their first occurrence, giving visible-leaf callers a stable render stream. Validation continues beyond maxTriangles so malformed BSP input cannot hide behind an output limit.

name: makeGridNormals
summary: MakeMeshNormals, including Baseq3's seam wrapping and up-to-three-point search through degenerate neighbours.  Positions stay immutable while every normal is derived so replacing vertices cannot affect later samples.

name: subdivideHorizontal
summary: Baseq3 R_SubdividePatchToGrid checks perpendicular distance to the chord, inserts the two de Casteljau half points and rechecks the same span.  This preserves its non-uniform grid and 65-point axis ceiling instead of applying one worst-case subdivision count to every quadratic block.

name: createFast
summary: Productive QVM drawing emits dozens to hundreds of commands each frame. Repeated array concatenation is quadratic in MiniLang, so accumulate into a geometric std list and expose the exact legacy array once the QVM returns.

name: sortStable
summary: Deterministic stable insertion ordering by the same unsigned packed key. Baseq3 only specifies key ordering; retaining tie order makes repeated submissions reproducible without changing renderer batching semantics.

name: lightScale
summary: R_LightScaleTexture with tables supplied by the renderer color-mapping owner.

name: mipMapFiltered
summary: Proper linear R_MipMap2 filter with the original power-of-two wrapping masks.

name: mipMapSimple
summary: Simple R_MipMap path. The one-dimensional case follows its adjacent-pixel rule.

name: resample
summary: Exact fixed-point sample positions and four-tap average from ResampleTexture.

name: hashValue
summary: Exact generateHashValue spelling rules: ASCII case fold, slash fold, extension omitted.

name: prepareUpload
summary: Produces every byte payload which Upload32 would hand to qglTexImage2D.

name: clipPlane
summary: R_ChopPolyBehindPlane keeps front/on points and uses a 0.5 unit epsilon.

name: computeFogNum
summary: R_ComputeFogNum from tr_mesh.c.  Fog zero is the renderer's no-fog slot; real BSP fogs start at one.  The original deliberately uses only the selected frame's sphere and entity origin (not the entity axes), and treats a sphere that merely touches a fog bound as outside that fog.

name: computeLod
summary: R_ComputeLOD. A single-level model still applies r_lodbias and clamps it, matching the original rather than bypassing the common tail.

name: cullModelDecision
summary: Control-flow core of R_CullModel.  The sphere tests can produce an early definitive answer only for normalized axes; clipped or disagreeing frame spheres fall through to the merged-frame box exactly like Baseq3.

name: lodProjection
summary: R_SetupProjection fields used by ProjectRadius.  This keeps the original float stores around tan() and matrix construction; all unused fields stay zero except projection[11], which supplies clip W = distance.

name: normalizeFrames
summary: R_AddMD3Surfaces first wraps continuous animation frames, then repairs both frame indexes to zero together if either remains outside the model.

name: projectRadius
summary: ProjectRadius uses the renderer's current view orientation and projection matrix. All intermediate stores remain binary32 as in the x86 Baseq3 path.

name: radiusFromBounds
summary: RadiusFromBounds from q_shared.c. It selects the most distant corner from the origin before taking the Euclidean length.

name: addAnimSurfaces
summary: R_AddAnimSurfaces: MD4 has one LOD and submits every surface with fog zero and no dlight map.

name: surfaceAnim
summary: RB_SurfaceAnim: blend all 3x4 bone matrices, then skin positions and normals by each vertex's weighted bone list.

name: md3
summary: The original renderer returns the first MD3 frame's bounds. The aggregate bounds cached by the asset reader are useful for culling, but are not the R_ModelBounds ABI and can move weapon/UI model placement for animated MD3s.

name: getTag
summary: R_GetTag accepts transiently oversized animation frames and clamps them to the final model frame while model switches settle.

name: lerpTag
summary: R_LerpTag uses frac for the end tag and (1-frac) for the start tag, then normalizes every interpolated basis vector independently.

name: msvcRand
summary: Baseq3's Windows build obtains rand() from the Microsoft C runtime.  Keep that 15-bit sequence here so normal deformations do not depend on the host.

name: affectsBounds
summary: Exact R_DlightBmodel point-to-expanded-bounds test after R_TransformDlights. The renderer stores the same result as a bit mask on every bmodel surface; the retained batch evaluates the equivalent predicate per light/model pair.

name: Batch
summary: origins/axes are parallel to triangles for moving brush models.  The original R_DlightBmodel transforms each world-space light into the model's local orientation before ProjectDlightTexture derives S/T and attenuation. Static world batches keep both arrays void and retain the cheaper path.

name: foggedColor
summary: RB_RenderFlare begins flareShader with the retained fog number. Its additive blend selects ACFF_MODULATE_RGB in FinishShader, so fog attenuates RGB only.

name: fogIndexAt
summary: RB_AddDlightFlares assigns each submitted light to the first fog whose axial brush bounds contain its origin.  Fog zero is the outside fallback.

name: parse
summary: ParseFlare in tr_bsp.c copies these fields directly from dsurface_t.

name: retireDynamicStates
summary: RB_RenderFlares frees active entries that were not submitted this frame. Slot identity matches the stable refdef dlight-array address used by Baseq3.

name: updateState
summary: RB_TestFlare changes visibility at now-1 and clamps the linear fade.

name: noWorldEntitySample
summary: R_SetupEntityLighting uses identityLight*150 for both components when the refdef has RDF_NOWORLDMODEL, then applies the renderer's unconditional 32-unit minimum-light add. The software renderer uses identityLight 1.0.

name: environmentUV
summary: RB_CalcEnvironmentTexCoords: reflect the normalized eye vector around the BSP vertex normal and map reflected Y/Z into texture space.

name: fogAdjustment
summary: FinishShader assigns fog modulation only when the shader's first stage is blended. Additive and inverse-source-color stages fade RGB, strict alpha stages fade alpha, and premultiplied-alpha stages fade RGBA. The final fog pass can then converge on the fog colour without glowing or opaque blended surfaces leaking through it.

name: mappedImageName
summary: Select the first actual image of a shader stage. This intentionally ignores blend animation and tcMod for the first playable slice, but understands both map/clampMap and the first frame of animMap without requiring a full shader parse.

name: shaderSeconds
summary: tr_backend.c subtracts refEntity_t.shaderTime before every shader-time consumer runs. Keep that conversion in one place so animated images, waves, deforms and tcMods all observe the same per-entity clock.

name: stageClamp
summary: RE_UploadCinematic configures scratch images with GL_CLAMP too.

name: stageColorAtEntity
summary: AGEN_PORTAL from tr_shade.c fades each deformed vertex according to its camera distance.  This is deliberately evaluated after stageColor so the portal generator replaces only alpha, exactly like the original renderer.

name: stageColorEntityIdentity
summary: Complete ComputeColors ordering from tr_shade.c. RGB generation may seed alpha, after which alphaGen either preserves or replaces it. identityLight is explicit so differential tests can cover the original overbright path; the software preview currently renders with identityLight 1.0.

name: transformUVEntityAt
summary: Baseq3 applies tcMods in declaration order. Turbulence additionally uses the unmodified world position of each vertex.

name: autosprite2Quad
summary: Autosprite2Deform keeps the long axis fixed and rotates only the two short edges toward the view. Source indexes preserve Quake's directed-edge test.

name: autospriteQuad
summary: AutospriteDeform rebuilds each independent pair of triangles as one square whose left/up axes follow the view. BSP extraction expands indexes, so the four original corners are recovered from each consecutive triangle pair.

name: build
summary: Compatibility builder: byte layout and single submission remain unchanged.

name: buildMaterials
summary: Static opaque primaries stay in the bit-identical base stream. Dynamic and supported blended stages become retained passes with their source UVs.

name: passChanges
summary: A retained pass exists for render-state reasons as well as for changing vertex data.  Blend, alpha-test, clamp, depth and polygon-offset state do not require MiniLang to rewrite every vertex every frame.  Keep those command bytes until topology/source data changes; animated, view-dependent and fog-modulated passes continue through the exact Quake update path.

name: refreshStagePass
summary: Refreshes a retained material batch when triangle/material topology is unchanged.  The byte buffers and nested source arrays keep their storage; callers fall back to buildMaterials when this returns false.

name: specularAlpha
summary: RB_CalcSpecularAlpha keeps this hard-coded light origin in the original renderer and raises the reflected view coefficient to the fourth power.

name: assemble
summary: Builds the hierarchy lower -> tag_torso -> upper -> tag_head -> head. The root transform places the complete player in the caller's model space.

name: attach
summary: Equivalent to the identity-local-axis case of CG_PositionRotatedEntityOnTag: tag.axis * parent.axis.

name: load
summary: Loads the three conventional player-model pieces without taking ownership of an archive or filesystem. This keeps asset lookup policy outside the renderer.

name: render
summary: Returns lower, upper and head triangles in one shared coordinate system. The limit applies independently to every surface, matching renderTriangles.

name: upperAttachment
summary: CG_AddPlayerWeapon attaches the weapon model to the animated torso rather than to the player root. Keep this transform renderer-neutral so view and world weapon models share the same item-model path.

name: createDetailed
summary: Detailed caches retain every triangle at build time. LOD selection happens after lookup, so all targets sharing an animation pose share one interpolation.

name: limitTriangles
summary: Evenly retain triangles across the stable lower/upper/head stream. This avoids starving later model pieces when the target budget is small.

name: phaseFor
summary: Round to the nearest one of phaseCount evenly spaced backlerp values. phaseCount=1 deliberately selects the current frame without interpolation.

name: renderTarget
summary: One call consumes one target from the current frame budget. Cache misses assemble/interpolate in identity space; hits only apply the target transform.

name: renderTargetDetailed
summary: Visibility and distance are evaluated before consuming the per-frame target budget. Visible targets use the complete cached mesh at close range.

name: selectLodTriangles
summary: The source stream is grouped by part and surface. Resetting the stride at every boundary guarantees that even a tiny face/gear surface stays present.

name: prepare
summary: Baseq3 renders at most the first viable portal view in a main view and refuses recursion.  Here distance provides deterministic draw-surface ordering when several selected portal faces share sort == SS_PORTAL.

name: refresh
summary: Rebuild only the changing quad/run buffers.  Shader parsing, PK3 image decoding and texture-slot assignment remain cached in the catalog.

name: drawStencilShadows
summary: RB_ShadowTessEnd increments front-facing volume sides and decrements back sides; mirrored portal views reverse those cull passes. RB_ShadowFinish then overlays 60% black wherever the resulting stencil value is non-zero.

name: shadowPolicies
summary: RB_ShadowTessEnd only receives opaque surfaces (SS_OPAQUE) outside fog. Cache that decision once per material-resolved MD3 surface rather than once per generated volume triangle. An unresolved shader is Baseq3's default opaque shader.

name: projectionShadowPointOriented
summary: RB_ProjectionShadowDeform in tr_shadows.c projects model vertices onto the entity's horizontal shadow plane along its sampled light direction.  The original clamps shallow light directions so projected shadows cannot become unbounded; retain that rule before dividing by the vertical component.

name: shadowVolumeSides
summary: R_AddEdgeDef/R_RenderShadowEdges/RB_ShadowTessEnd. Every returned item is the four vertices of one GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP silhouette side. The original 32-edge-per-start-vertex overflow rule is retained for malformed meshes.

name: Material
summary: Field layout intentionally matches playable_materials.Material so the existing multi-pass native batch path can consume QVM materials directly.

name: projectionShadowEligible
summary: R_AddMD3Surfaces only submits a projection-shadow draw surface when the source surface resolves to SS_OPAQUE and lies outside fog. Geometry expansion keeps every projected triangle directly after its source triangle, allowing the material bridge to apply the original shader policy after skin/custom shader resolution without duplicating the shader registry here.

name: refresh
summary: Rebinds moving geometry while retaining decoded images and shader programs. Newly encountered registered shaders are appended within the original slot range.

name: strippedName
summary: R_FindShader strips the extension before consulting shader text.

name: bindCatalog
summary: Catalog is intentionally structural: both qvm_scene_materials.Catalog and qvm_2d_batch.Catalog expose materials[*].stages.

name: payloadVector
summary: QVM refEntity_t is a fixed 140-byte 32-bit ABI record from tr_types.h.

name: apply
summary: Asset handles are the renderer's stable shader objects in MiniQuake3. By replacing their resolved names in place, existing cgame/UI handles reach the replacement in both the scene and 2D material resolvers without re-registering.

name: handle
summary: Return the stable renderer handle previously associated with this source shader. Registration after a remap must not allocate a disconnected object.

name: stripped
summary: R_FindShader stores extensionless names and R_RemapShader compares those names case-insensitively after COM_StripExtension.

name: modes
summary: Original static tables exposed as deterministic native contracts.

name: build
summary: Baseq3 emits a closed six-sided triangle strip through immediate OpenGL. Positions intentionally remain relative to zero because R_RotateForEntity uses the world orientation for every non-model entity.

name: addQuadStampExt
summary: RB_AddQuadStampExt emits two triangles. RB_CheckOverflow flushes even when the resulting count exactly reaches a SHADER_MAX_* sentinel.

name: surfaceSprite
summary: RB_SurfaceSprite rotates the camera-facing left/up basis around the view axis, mirrors left for mirror views, then uses the standard quad stamp.

name: selectAxis
summary: RB_SurfaceGrid always retains both outer edges and keeps an interior row or column when its subdivision error is within the current volume LOD error.

name: submit
summary: Mirrors RB_SurfaceGrid's conservative row capacity calculation. Consecutive batches repeat their boundary row so every batch remains independently drawable.

name: lerpVertexesCached
summary: LerpMeshVertexes selects the new frame directly when backlerp is zero. With interpolation it blends decoded normals and applies Quake's Q_rsqrt pass.

name: submit
summary: RB_CHECKOVERFLOW ends the current tessellation before this surface when the combined counts exceed capacity. MD3 submission itself does not alter lights.

name: tableValue
summary: R_Init builds this 1024-entry table with a 1023 divisor. Preserve the float operation before the double-precision angle and the final binary32 store.

name: submitFace
summary: RB_SurfaceFace checks overflow first and then adds its dlight mask. Every point uses the plane normal because the packed face points carry no normals.

name: submitTriangles
summary: RB_SurfaceTriangles ORs its dlight mask before RB_CHECKOVERFLOW. Therefore a flush clears the aggregate mask, although each copied vertex keeps the mask.

name: append
summary: Copies positions, base texture coordinates and packed color, then emits a fan.

name: checkOverflow
summary: Mirrors RB_CheckOverflow's strict '< MAX' checks and surface restart.

name: railCoreRaw
summary: Direct equivalent of DoRailCore. len is the integral result retained by the original caller after VectorNormalize's float return is converted to int.

name: railDiscs
summary: Direct equivalent of DoRailDiscs, retaining its one-segment shortening for shots long enough to contain more than one nominal segment.

name: GL_Bind
summary: C-named texture facade.  These calls use the productive two-TMU cache.

name: HSVtoRGB
summary: Exact tr_bsp.c six-sector HSV development-lightmap conversion.

name: R_RenderGlyph
summary: FreeType performs the outline scan conversion. The facade consumes that exact coverage buffer and retains all of tr_font.c's metric/lifetime rules.

name: LogLight
summary: Preserves the original function's else-if quirk: Z is tested only when Y did not replace the current maximum.

name: R_PlaneForSurface
summary: Surface is {kind, plane} for faces or {kind, vertices, indexes} for meshes.

name: DeformText
summary: The original text deformation converts one four-corner surface into atlas quads. Return the complete indexed geometry so callers are not coupled to the global tess scratch buffer.

name: ProjectDlightTexture
summary: Exact CPU half of ProjectDlightTexture. The productive draw path below uses playable_dynamic_lights for the same projection and blend submission.

name: R_ArrayElementDiscrete
summary: R_ArrayElementDiscrete emits the currently selected texture-coordinate set, packed color and position for one array element.

name: R_DrawStripElements
summary: Preserve the original alternating winding test. Each returned list is one GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP and repeats three indexes when a new strip is required.

name: RB_IterateStagesGeneric
summary: The retained renderer creates one StagePass per original shader stage. These entry points all submit those passes, dynamic lights and fog in original order through the productive rasterizer.

name: LodErrorForVolume
summary: Exact LodErrorForVolume transform and clamp.  axis rows are the entity's local basis and viewForward is viewParms.or.axis[0].

name: RB_SurfaceAxis
summary: Original null-model diagnostic geometry: three 16-unit colored axes.  It is exposed only for RT_MODEL fallback diagnostics and never substitutes a BSP, MD3 or generated entity surface in the productive renderer.

name: RB_SurfaceDisplayList
summary: Display lists are a real legacy backend command, retained as a typed command so a GL backend can issue qglCallList after RB_BeginSurface state setup.

name: RB_SurfaceEntity
summary: Complete procedural entity dispatch from RB_SurfaceEntity.

name: RB_SurfaceFlare
summary: The active Baseq3 build intentionally makes flares a no-op in tr_surface.c; flare visibility/drawing is handled by the dedicated flare renderer.

name: VectorArrayNormalize
summary: The C routine mutates vec4_t rows.  Returning normalized vec3 rows gives callers the same values while keeping the MiniLang API allocation safe.

name: R_AddWorldSurfaces
summary: Productive world entry: the retained selector performs the same leaf/PVS, frustum, backface and surface de-duplication before BSP triangle expansion.

name: setupFrustum
summary: R_SetupFrustum constructs the four side planes from the current refdef. Quake's view axes are forward, left and up, so the signed cosine terms intentionally follow the original renderer rather than a right-vector API.

name: worldToLocal
summary: Baseq3's R_WorldToLocal projects the supplied vector onto the axes. The caller subtracts the origin when a position rather than a vector is used.

name: pointLeaf
summary: This is CM_PointLeafnum's BSP walk, kept here so selection needs no loaded collision world. Negative children encode leaves as -1-leafIndex.

name: prepareCachedRetained
summary: Keep the already-flattened triangle stream when camera motion does not alter the visible face order. PVS/frustum metadata is still refreshed, while the hot frame path avoids rebuilding an identical immutable array.

name: sameFaces
summary: Camera checks run regularly, but rebuilding retained material commands is only necessary when the selected BSP face set actually changes.

name: cvarNames
summary: The declarations below are part of server.h's public surface even though MiniLang stores cvars in the managed Cvars value and dispatches functions from their owning modules.  Keeping the original spelling/order here gives ABI tooling a single canonical manifest without introducing duplicate stubs.

name: toSnapshotEntity
summary: Productive projections. They deliberately preserve the canonical fixed-size rings while adapting the managed representation used by execution modules.

name: clientCommandFn
summary: These signatures match client_message.Services and can be installed directly in network_ingress.Services.

name: calculate
summary: Updates each engine client's ping and mirrors active, non-bot values into the corresponding game playerState, preserving the original early-continue rules.

name: CommandRuntime
summary: Adapter for the four download builtins in SV_ExecuteClientCommand.  Keeping it next to the window state makes the reliable command path and the snapshot writer operate on the same live download cursor.

name: run
summary: Runs one outer server frame. All platform/VM effects are explicit services; ping, pause, timeout and snapshot policy use their productive port modules.

name: SV_ExpandNewlines
summary: SV_ExpandNewlines uses a 1024-byte static buffer and stops with three bytes left, because a final input newline needs two output bytes plus NUL.

name: decodeMessage
summary: The three compressed client header longs remain logically unread by the caller. Payload are restored exactly before the payload XOR begins.

name: encode
summary: First four physical bytes remain clear. The initial compressed long is read only to reproduce the original msg_t cursor save/restore behavior.

name: transmitPayload
summary: Snapshot construction already appends svc_EOF before reaching the netchan boundary. This entry point applies the server XOR and drains every fragment without adding a second terminator.

name: Services
summary: The game-facing command and movement callbacks remain explicit host services. This lets the ingress path run before the concrete game module is installed and avoids coupling the protocol parser to game state.

name: processNetchan
summary: Concrete SV_Netchan_Process adapter. Tests can replace processFn with the deterministic host callback used by the unchanged-C transition oracle.

name: PauseResult
summary: cvarSets is the number of Cvar_Set calls made by the original function. The result carries the resulting sv_paused integer so callers can apply it.

name: writeDownload
summary: Runtime level is attached only for the synchronous duration of sendSnapshot.

name: acknowledge
summary: The stale acknowledgement repair used before snapshot construction in SV_ExecuteClientMessage. Future acknowledgements are retained by Baseq3.

name: add
summary: Exact reliable ring insertion rule from SV_AddServerCommand. A false result represents the original connection-drop boundary when 65 commands are pending.

name: updateServerCommandsToClient
summary: Exact SV_UpdateServerCommandsToClient loop. Each unacknowledged command is embedded as svc_serverCommand, its absolute sequence, and a C string.

name: addEntitiesVisibleFromPoint
summary: Host callbacks provide CM_PointLeafnum, leaf area/cluster, CM_WriteAreaBits, CM_ClusterPVS and CM_AreasConnected. Portal recursion stays in MiniLang.

name: sortEntityNumbers
summary: SV_QsortEntityNumbers semantics. Keep the caller-owned input detached while using the standard-library O(n log n) sort instead of repeatedly concatenating arrays in an O(n^2) insertion sort on every client snapshot.

name: baselineFor
summary: Baselines are supplied by the server host as entityState records. Keeping this lookup outside the game-state model avoids importing svEntity_t.

name: deltaFrameValid
summary: The host supplies the frame indexed by deltaMessage. This predicate mirrors the rejection conditions in SV_WriteSnapshotToClient before it is used.

name: emitPacketEntities
summary: Exact SV_EmitPacketEntities two-way sorted merge. `oldFrame` may be void for a non-delta snapshot. Returns the number of emitted entity records; the protocol terminator is not counted.

name: entityAt
summary: Snapshot-ring ownership remains with the server host. This helper applies Baseq3's modulo addressing and rejects an invalid host boundary explicitly.

name: writeSnapshotPayload
summary: Snapshot payload beginning at svc_snapshot. The outer sequencing, flags and padding are provided by server/snapshot_send.ml.

name: syncLevel
summary: Refresh game-owned state and spatial metadata while preserving the server's per-snapshot deduplication counters and persistent packet-entity ring.

name: sendClientMessages
summary: SV_SendClientMessages. Snapshot construction/transmission stays behind the callback so the scheduler can drive snapshot_send.sendClientSnapshot without duplicating the already-ported packet pipeline.

name: sendMessageToClient
summary: SV_SendMessageToClient plus the svc_EOF written by SV_Netchan_Transmit. `transmitFn` is the explicit server-netchan boundary.

name: hashKey
summary: Com_HashKey uses signed char values on the pinned MSVC reference build.

name: sectorList
summary: SV_SectorList_f is a diagnostic command, but it deliberately walks the same intrusive sector chains used by collision queries.  Baseq3 prints all 64 statically allocated slots; only the first 31 belong to the depth-four tree and the remaining slots consequently report zero entities.

name: Plane
summary: Remaining code/game/q_math.c runtime surface. Arrays own the output that the C API writes through pointer arguments; mutating variants retain C behavior.

name: __lwbrx
summary: The three names below are PowerPC compiler intrinsics in the original header. Keeping managed equivalents makes the header surface complete while the Win32 target naturally uses the Big/Little helpers above.

name: VmState
summary: vm_s is pointer-heavy in C. The port keeps equivalent ownership and state fields as managed values while retaining the two assembler-visible offsets.

name: keynumToString
summary: Exact cl_keys.c textual key ABI used by the original controls menu.  Keys absent from keynames[] intentionally retain the lowercase 0xnn spelling.

name: validKey
summary: These state helpers mirror cl_keys.c and cl_ui.c closely enough to be shared by native input, the UI QVM and the cgame QVM without exposing VM memory.

name: encodeQtime
summary: qtime_t is nine consecutive native-QVM ints. Its month and year retain the C library conventions used by Com_RealTime (January=0, year since 1900).

name: sampleRealTime
summary: The standard library exposes portable UTC/local wall clocks but not the platform DST flag. -1 is the C tm value for "unknown" and preserves the ABI without claiming a wrong daylight-saving state.

name: readPrecompToken
summary: Full botlib l_precomp.c ownership adapter. This keeps the existing QVM ABI while sharing the same pc_parser registry used by game/cgame/UI hosts.

name: VM_Indent
summary: Debug helpers from vm_interpreted.c.  The C implementation returns a pointer into a static forty-space string; MiniLang returns the equivalent immutable suffix.  Stack traces retain the original frame layout: [return pc, previous program stack] at offsets 0 and 4.

name: EmitMovEAXEDI
summary: Original x86 peephole entry points. These produce their exact byte forms.

name: Inst
summary: PowerPC instruction constructors preserve the original bit layouts.

name: gameDuplicate546Count
summary: The original table intentionally assigns -546 to two adjacent imports.

name: parseHex
summary: ParseHex intentionally ignores non-hex characters rather than terminating.

name: vm2c
summary: VM_VM2C is an identity conversion in the shipped engine.
